description: Register a new experience and get its manage key. Returns game, key and the first version id. The key is shown only here and controls the listing forever — save it. This creates a draft; upload_build is what sends it for review.

aspect.description: Shape on screen. Empty fills the screen.

author.description: The creator name players see, 2 to 30 characters.

devices.description: Devices actually tested. Mobile requires touch, voice or camera among inputs.

email.description: Reviewer contact address. Players never see it.

how.description: How to take part: the controls and how to begin.

inputs.description: How people interact. At least one.

kind.description: 'sdk' if the entry page calls arcade.ready(), otherwise 'web'. Detected from the build too.

releaseNotes.description: Public changelog notes, shown only after this build is approved.

rights.description: Confirm the experience is yours to share, including its art, music and code.

terms.description: Confirm you agree to the arcade.fun terms and community guidelines.

title.description: What the experience is called, 2 to 60 characters.

wallet.description: Solana address that receives this listing's creator trading fees. Every public listing launches with its own coin.

name: create_experience
title: Create an experience
